text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf has claimed more than<n>seven
crowns: an unprecedented<n>feat. She has cemented
her place in<n>history as an emperor among<n>emperors.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
What could possibly serve as a<n>suitable reward?
We think it over<n>together during a well-deserved
moment of peace.
